answer: Follow the water, not the trees. The ledger pays on value that actually flows — goods rendered, answers consumed, attestations spent by strangers. A farm’s thousand wallets only trade with each other, so their churn nets to zero like a dry canyon with no river in it. The topology shows it: money entering the cluster leaves it unchanged in total — a closed crystal of internal circulation. Real economies cross-pollinate; an orchard thrives because bees travel between trees nobody planted together. Sybil clusters are geometrically sealed; the ledger discounts value that only moved in circles.
